package container

import "github.com/buildwarden/buildwarden/driver/drivercmd"

var settings = []drivercmd.Setting{
	{Name: "runtime", Type: drivercmd.String,
		Flag: "runtime", Key: "driver.container.cli",
		Aliases: []string{"runtime.cli"}, Env: "WARDEN_CTR_CLI",
		Commands: drivercmd.EveryCommand,
		Usage:    "container runtime (finch, docker, podman)"},
	{Name: "relay-image", Type: drivercmd.String,
		Key:     "driver.container.relay_image",
		Aliases: []string{"runtime.relay_image"}, Env: "WARDEN_IMAGE",
		Commands: []string{"run"},
		Usage:    "relay image reference, or dev to build it from source"},
}

var slots = drivercmd.Setting{Name: "slots", Type: drivercmd.Int, Flag: "slots",
	Commands: []string{"setup"}, Usage: "build slots"}

var ages = append([]drivercmd.Setting{},
	drivercmd.Setting{Name: "image-refresh-after", Type: drivercmd.Age,
		Aliases:  []string{"vm.image_refresh_after"},
		Common:   "image_refresh_after",
		Commands: []string{"run"}, Usage: "age at which a prepared image is refreshed"},
	drivercmd.Setting{Name: "image-min-grace", Type: drivercmd.Age,
		Common:   "image_min_grace",
		Commands: []string{"run"}, Usage: "least evaluation grace"})

// Not settings: another type's literal, a flag call and a toml tag, none of
// which is read in a driver directory.
var other = []Other{{Flag: "not-a-setting", Key: "driver.container.not_a_setting"}}

type Config struct {
	Network string `toml:"not_read_here"`
}

func init() {
	root.Flags().String("not-read-here", "", "")
}
